key_decisions.decision: Preserves the precise tomorrow promise and bodily harm to horses rather than a vague disabling order.
Retains all pursuit endpoints, eastward qualifier and the no-survivor claim.
Keeps the exact command/fulfillment correspondence and real animal harm.
Preserves all-person and all-breathing claims and distinct burning of the city.
Retains the comprehensive summary and stated Mosaic command without approval commentary.
Preserves the explicit limit on burning despite the broad destruction claims.
Distinguishes retained animals and goods from killed people; keeps the exhaustive breathing formula.
Keeps the sole stated peace exception and distinguishes it from conquest.
Retains direct divine hardening, purpose and absence of mercy without softening them into mere permission.
Keeps the named people, three towns and two larger regions with the stated destruction.
Preserves the explicit surviving locations alongside the totalizing regional claim.
Retains the whole-land summary and rest language without erasing later notices of land still unpossessed.
